question: In which Massachusetts counties does Eastern Bankshares have its highest deposit market share?
headline: Eastern Bankshares's highest deposit market share in Massachusetts counties is in Plymouth County (17.9%, ranked #2), followed by Essex County (11.3%, ranked #3), as of June 30, 2026.
insights: Plymouth County has the highest share at 17.89% of deposits, behind only the leader in that county; Essex County is next at 11.35% (rank #3 of 31 organizations).

Middlesex County (5.87%, rank #5) is the next-highest share, while Suffolk County has the largest deposit balance ($9.37B) but only a 2.46% share, ranked #5 among 34 organizations, because the county's market is much larger ($381.2B).

question: Deposit market share in the Boston metro area as of June 30, 2026, with change from 2025
headline: State Street leads the Boston metro with 41.7% of deposits as of June 30, 2026 (up 2.98 points), but it is booked at one office; among branch-based banks, Bank of America leads with 16.0% (down 1.36 points).
insights: The Boston-Cambridge-Newton metro held $580.3B in deposits, up 8.16% from 2025, across 91 organizations and 1,318 branches (Summary of Deposits, as of June 30, 2026).

Market concentration rose: the HHI is 2,174, above the 1,800 threshold for a highly concentrated market, up from 1,997 a year earlier. State Street's gain and the 2025-26 mergers (Eastern Bankshares, Independent Bank Corp, Beacon Financial, NB BCORP) contribute to that change.

State Street's deposits are mostly custody, internet or wholesale funds booked at a head office, so its share is not a measure of branch customers. Among branch-based organizations, Citizens Financial (10.1%, 146 branches) ranks second and Banco Santander (5.7%) third.
Share changes for Eastern Bankshares, Independent Bank Corp, Beacon Financial and NB BCORP can reflect deposits re-booked after their mergers, not customer shifts.

question: Compare CRE, residential and C&I loan shares for New England banking organizations with $10B-$50B in assets, 2026Q2
headline: Independent Bank Corp (MA) has the highest CRE loan share at 56.40% of gross loans among the three New England organizations with $10B-$50B in assets, as of 2026Q2.
insights: CRE share (construction, multifamily and nonfarm nonresidential): Independent Bank Corp (MA) 56.40%, Beacon Financial Corp 53.84%, Eastern Bankshares Inc 42.58%; the group aggregate is 50.22%.
Residential share (1-4 family, incl. home equity): Eastern Bankshares 31.30% (the highest), Independent Bank Corp (MA) 29.36%, Beacon Financial 21.38% (the lowest); the group aggregate is 27.73%.
C&I share: Beacon Financial 20.71% (the highest), Eastern Bankshares 14.41%, Independent Bank Corp (MA) 10.32% (the lowest); the group aggregate is 15.03%.
Eastern Bankshares is the largest of the three at $31.1B in assets and $23.3B in gross loans. Only three organizations fall in this band in New England, so the peer group is small.
